name: cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily A member 6

function.text: CYP2A6 encodes cytochrome P450 2A6). Annotated molecular activities include arachidonate epoxygenase activity and coumarin 7-hydroxylase activity. It participates in coumarin catabolic process and coumarin metabolic process.
